subject: general
question:
Which of the following pairs of "course – feature" is correct for the Himalayan rivers?

I. Upper course – Meander

II. Lower course – Ox bow lake
solution:
The correct answer is __**Option 4**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **In the Himalayan rivers, **the lower course is indeed characterized by **the formation of meanders.**
